real_input_preflight.decoder: databento DBN (ohlcv-1m), lazily imported by r1.dev_adapter
real_input_preflight.timestamp_semantics: ts_event = bar START, ns UTC, converted once to ET minute-of-day
real_input_preflight.duplicate_policy: a second record for one ET minute is a refusal; none occurred

structural_universe.required_anchors_present_on_real_data: 252 of 252 event dates carry C(08:29), C(08:31), O(08:33) and O(09:29)
structural_universe.span_note: matches R1_SEALED_ERRATA.md E-1; the sealed D.3 span line is descriptively wrong and was not edited

e4.definition: R_init == 0 exactly, R_init = C(08:31) - C(08:29) (sealed C.1)
e4.exposed: counts and identifiers only; no sign, magnitude, distribution, direction, price or return

c2_dispersion_only.purpose: DISPERSION ONLY -- the OD-3 nuisance parameter
c2_dispersion_only.construction: sealed K.2 / I.3: non-event days, direction = sign(C(08:31)-C(08:29)), O(08:33) -> O(09:29)

s_hat_crosscheck.note: the sealed I.3 dispersion is over the directed PRICE CHANGE; the round-turn cost is a constant per event, so it cancels in a standard deviation. Verified identical.

od3_power_gate.formula: SE_hat = s_hat / sqrt(n); MDE_50 = M + 1.645*SE_hat; MDE_80 = M + 2.486*SE_hat (sealed I.3)
od3_power_gate.resolution_note: sealed I.3: if the CI half-width would exceed M the design cannot distinguish supported from excluded
od3_power_gate.decided_by: Aaron (Owner). The machinery neither decides nor recommends.
